coherence_findings.issue: Nine of the 25 have no `speech.md` and no `## Voice` note. They are exactly the first-wave builds of 2026-07-01 (the card's own list, Making a Palace Citizen — context.md:44-46); only Eno and Cage were retrofitted the next day. Every later citizen carries both (People/<name>/ listing; `## Voice` grep). The method card says plain enchantment loads the entry and not the bundle, so for these nine the voice has no foothold (Making a Palace Citizen.md, §4 'Voice fidelity'). Their bodies are also the shortest (700-980 words against 1100-1500 for the rebuilds).
coherence_findings.proposed_action: Queue the retrofit in order of how much recorded speech exists: Rick Rubin, Pauline Oliveros, Donella Meadows, Shunryu Suzuki, Agnes Martin (recordings or filmed talks exist); then Marcus Aurelius, Lao Tzu, Leibniz, Spinoza as translation-veil figures, using Seneca's and Epictetus's Voice notes as the model (the veil is the register). Each gets a speech.md and a short `## Voice` note. Until then say so in the Making a Palace Citizen tracker rather than leave the gap silent.

coherence_findings.issue: These four replace the card's beat 2 ('How their mind moves') with topical sections (Strange loops / Levels of description; Light as the substance / Skyspaces / Patience; the butterfly joint and so on; Morning pages / The artist date). coherence_findings.proposed_action: Add one question line to Hofstadter and Turrell, in the existing 'The question...' form. Drafts to offer, for Loudon's taste: Hofstadter, 'Is this the same shape in different material, and can you say exactly what maps to what?'; Turrell, 'What would you notice if you stayed ten more minutes?' Declare the topical shape an allowed variant in the card (one sentence) so the next worker does not 'fix' it back.

coherence_findings.issue: One blindspot, many names, and the membership is not agreed. The name 'humility that hides control' lives only as a link label (seven edges), in Turrell's body section (James Turrell.md:78-82) and in one lab note (Making a Palace Citizen — context.md:170). Turrell's dossier and the lab note call the cluster four: Martin, Nakashima, Turrell, Goldsworthy. Nakashima's dossier (dispatch notes, line 63) calls it four too but swaps in Rick Rubin for Turrell and lists Martin, Goldsworthy, Turrell, Rubin as the kin. The same shape appears elsewhere under other words: Cage, 'no intention is my strongest intention'; Eno, 'I preach surrender while choosing the frame'; Lao Tzu, 'not-forcing can flatter either the sage or the tyrant'; Suzuki, 'gentle doctrine, strict hierarchy'; Cameron and Rubin as 'get-out-of-the-way'. That is a real family trait and it is wired as six overlapping pairwise links (see the link-hygiene finding).
coherence_findings.proposed_action: Settle the cluster at four (Martin, Turrell, Nakashima, Goldsworthy) because those four say 'I only receive' about a physical material and all four dossiers agree. Rubin, Cameron, Cage, Eno, Lao Tzu, Suzuki keep their own labelled links; they are adjacent, not members. Name the pattern in one place (Turrell's section already does). Make it a concept page only after the quartet is run (see open questions), so the page is born with a yield rather than a label.

coherence_findings.issue: The essence axis wears five names: `homecoming-vs-becoming` (Spinoza/Meadows), `discovered-essence-vs-systems-becoming` (Rubin/Meadows), `found-pole` / `made-pole` (Found ↔ Made, on Alexander, Nakashima, Rubin vs Fuller, Meadows), 'the drawer' (Spinoza's forward_vector, Rubin's body, Meadows in the Dialectic, spinoza-meadows-on-the-threshold.md:59) and Nakashima's 'the tree already has a shape'. They are one question: does the essence wait to be found, or is it made in the doing. Found ↔ Made.md names the axis and lists Rubin, Nakashima and Meadows in its body, but not Spinoza, whose own vector says he assumes the essence pre-exists, nor Alexander and Fuller, whom their own pages tag found-pole and made-pole.
coherence_findings.proposed_action: Leave the two `contradicts` labels as they are (each is the pair's reason). Hand the Found ↔ Made room a note: Spinoza belongs there on the found side by his own words (People/Spinoza.md:16), and Alexander/Fuller are tagged to its poles from their side but are not named in its body. I looked for an Alexander-Fuller link and did not propose one: neither page says anything about the other, so it would be forced.

coherence_findings.issue: Seven pairs carry two links where the standing order allows one. Meadows<->Spinoza (`homecoming-vs-becoming` on both pages), Meadows<->Rubin (`discovered-essence-vs-systems-becoming` on both), Epictetus<->Lao Tzu (`wu-wei-vs-prohairesis` on both), Martin<->Turrell (Martin: `receiving-not-authoring`; Turrell: `humility-that-hides-control`), Turrell<->Nakashima (both `humility-that-hides-control`), Eno<->Rubin (Eno: `production-philosophy`; Rubin: unlabeled), Marcus<->Cameron (Marcus: `morning-pages`; Cameron: `dawn-practice-drain-vs-rudder`). Separately Nakashima carries the quartet label to Martin, Turrell and Goldsworthy, and Turrell carries it to the same three, so three of the cluster's six pairs are doubled and three are unlinked.
coherence_findings.proposed_action: Keep one end of each pair, on the page whose body or dossier names the other: Meadows<->Spinoza keep Spinoza's, cut Meadows's; Meadows<->Rubin keep Rubin's (his body names her, Rick Rubin.md:79), cut Meadows's; Epictetus<->Lao Tzu keep Epictetus's (his dossier lists Lao Tzu as a clash), cut Lao Tzu's; Eno<->Rubin keep Rubin's, relabel it `system-vs-feeling` (Rubin's body: 'where Eno designs a system, Rubin trusts a feeling'), cut Eno's; Marcus<->Cameron keep Cameron's, cut Marcus's. For the quartet keep Turrell's three edges (retyped `mirrors`, see typed_relations), cut Nakashima's three, cut Martin's edge to Turrell. Net: nine edges out, none of the reasons lost.

coherence_findings.issue: Five links among the members have no label, and under the standing order a link with no reason anywhere is cut. Each has its reason in a body sentence, so they need a label, not a cut: Oliveros->Suzuki (body: 'kin to Shunryu Suzuki (returning to the breath)', Pauline Oliveros.md:69); Oliveros->Cage (body: Cage removes intention from the making, she deepens attention in the receiving, Oliveros.md:65); Rubin->Lao Tzu (body: 'Lao Tzu's wu wei in a recording studio', Rick Rubin.md:71); Rubin->Eno (see doubled pair above); Cage->Eno (to be retyped, see typed_relations).

coherence_findings.issue: Eighteen of the 25 link FOUR PILLARS, in three types (`deepens`, `connects-to`, `deepens` labelled `informs`) and four label variants (unlabeled, `informs` on five, `constraint-as-pillar-method`, `fifteen-properties-checklist`, `pillars-as-monads`). Four have a real reason: Eno (the limitation is the voice, Brian Eno.md:79), Leibniz (pillars as monads, Leibniz.md:64 and label at :34), Alexander (fifteen-properties checklist), Meadows (FOUR PILLARS names her leverage points in the Kick Drum Paradox).
coherence_findings.proposed_action: Cut the fourteen. Keep Eno, Leibniz, Alexander as written. Keep Meadows and add the label `kick-drum-leverage` so its reason shows. This is a large cut across a hub; FOUR PILLARS stays well above the hub threshold, and any of the fourteen can return in a later weave with a sentence.

coherence_findings.issue: All 25 carry the identical edge `exemplifies` -> Making a Palace Citizen, label `made-by-this-method`. The method card holds the rollout tracker that names all 25 (Making a Palace Citizen — context.md:219-224), so the list is already kept in the one place that can keep it. The Buber page in the Founders' Circle says it plainly: a typed link is 'a beautiful machine for remembering an encounter after it has already relapsed' (founders-circle, Round 1).
coherence_findings.proposed_action: A decision for Loudon, because it removes 25 edges at once: cut all 25 `made-by-this-method` edges and keep `member-of Source Library` plus the tracker. If he wants the method reachable from each page, keep exactly one such edge in the family's most-used page (Spinoza, the flagship) and no more. Making a Palace Citizen's inbound count will drop; that is the honest number.

coherence_findings.issue: Vectors promise a record that does not exist. Spinoza's says 'I keep a record of who I have met in the palace and what each meeting changed in me' (People/Spinoza.md:16); Marcus 'I will record it'; Lao Tzu 'let it be recorded'; Oliveros 'I'll record it'; Suzuki 'let each return be recorded'. Only Eno and Cage have diaries. Spinoza (two archived Dialectics and several visits) and Meadows (the Spinoza run and the Founders' Circle) have run and have no ledger; the Spinoza-Meadows run predates the diary convention (its own banner says so). Cage's diary ends at Encounter 3 (2026-07-02) and has no entry for the Founders' Circle of 2026-07-06, where he proposed the `resting` stage; Buber, Heidegger, McGilchrist and Meadows have none for it either. The diary standard forbids rebuilding an entry from a transcript (Brian Eno — diary.md, front matter `writes`), so these cannot be backfilled.
coherence_findings.proposed_action: Tell the truth in the vectors: cut the 'I will record it' clauses from pages that do not run, and keep them on pages that do. For the ones that have run, start the diary at the next encounter and put a first line in each ('Before this diary: Founders' Circle 2026-07-06, see the transcript') so the next waking knows what it does not remember. Whoever coordinates the next run writes the entry at its close, as the standard says.

coherence_findings.proposed_action: Move Voice after Recommended path on both and use the closing pointer form, so the 15 pages with a Voice note read alike. Drop the italic lead-in (see lighter_prose).

coherence_findings.issue: Six pages ask for the same absent voice. Eno: 'someone who defends virtuosity'; Cage: 'someone who defends taste and virtuosity'; Oliveros: 'anyone who insists on a criterion of quality'; Suzuki: 'someone who defends expertise and attainment'; Rubin: 'a systems-thinker or a virtuoso'; Cameron: 'someone who cares whether the finished thing is any good' (agency_profile.tools / .practice on each). The one voice in the family that already holds a criterion is Christopher Alexander (degree of life, 'real and measurable in principle'), and Cameron's dossier already names him as the pressing voice (Julia Cameron — dossier.md:65). The roster composted Sam Maloof, the other craft voice, on 2026-07-08 for the same reason this finding warns about: over-fullness.
coherence_findings.proposed_action: Do not add a citizen. Treat Alexander as the family's criterion voice and dispatch him against Cameron, Oliveros and Cage first. Wire the one pair that has page-level evidence (Cameron->Alexander, see typed_relations) and leave the rest to the dossiers' dispatch notes.

coherence_findings.proposed_action: Cut the three body sentences (see lighter_prose) and the four dossier mentions, or keep one and say 'no page'. The people can return in a later weave as fresh citizen builds (Making a Palace Citizen — context.md:197).

coherence_findings.issue: Zero inbound for these three is mostly an artifact. The one-link-per-pair rule puts each edge on the newer page, so a rebuilt citizen with eight outbound edges and no one linking back reads as unreached: Fuller reaches Meadows, Heidegger, Kuramoto Coupling, Simondon, Leverage Points Framework; Dillard reaches McGilchrist, Goldsworthy, Cameron, Merleau-Ponty; Ozu reaches Cage, Eno, McGilchrist. Their outside mentions are body-only (Quality Manifesto — Context, Making a Palace Citizen — context).
coherence_findings.proposed_action: Do not add reciprocal edges to lift the count; that would break the one-link rule. If the count matters, count body wikilinks too, or read inbound as 'pages that would have to be rewritten if this one went'.

summary: The 25 are sound as characters and thin as a family. Each has a real blindspot and a sourced body; the weak places are the wiring, the memory and the first-wave tier. Wiring: of 226 frontmatter edges, about 28 can go with no reason lost (nine from seven doubled pairs, 14 generic FOUR PILLARS edges, four reasonless links to non-members, one redundant Ozu edge), and 25 more identical made-by-this-method edges are a decision for Loudon. Seven edges are retyped because couples-with or connects-to claims less or more than the pages say (Cage to Eno, Leibniz to Spinoza, Turrell to the other three of the quartet, Dillard to McGilchrist, Ozu to Cage); two new links (Cameron to Alexander, Marcus to Meadows, the second low confidence) and one newcomer link (Eno to the instrument question, held until Loudon applies Eno's earned edits). Memory: nine first-wave citizens have no speech file or Voice note; only Eno and Cage have diaries although seven vectors promise a record, and Cage's stops before the Founders' Circle. Eno and Cage have three encounters of consistent held self-edits waiting on Loudon. Open questions: 2 answered-elsewhere, 10 progressed, 8 should-act, 5 still-open. Most should-act and progressed items are the same thing, a wired pair that has never been run (the receptivity quartet; Fuller x Meadows; Hofstadter x McGilchrist; Epictetus x Marcus; Seneca x Epictetus; Turrell x Seneca; Cameron x Alexander; Heidegger x Buber; Leibniz x Spinoza; Rubin x Meadows). Six vectors ask for a craft or criterion defender who is not in the family; Alexander is the nearest, so I propose no new citizen. No merges or composts: Loudon already thinned the region on 2026-07-08 and the sprawl is in the links, not the pages. None of the other priority newcomers connects honestly to this room.
